fact: The 2021-2023 yearbook (July 2025) says the national health information system still struggles to capture all data, DHIS2 is used at district level, with the recommendation to set up DHIS2 at the level of health facilities, so primary clinics do not enter their own reports.
title: Annuaire statistique sanitaire 2021-2023
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de la Population
